items.title: AJ Bell unveils new brand identity - International Adviser
items.raw_summary: AJ Bell has revealed a new brand identity to be rolled out across the platform and AJ Bell Investments in a phased approach from September. While AJ Bell’s brand name will remain the same, the firm is launching a new logo that will feature a bell graphic as well as a new font and colour palette to reinforce its ‘feel good investing’ campaign. The new brand identity will appear across AJ Bell’s ongoing advertising featuring Anita Ward’s Ring My Bell track, as well as being showcased across the AJ Bell Great Run series in 2026, starting with the Great North Run taking place on 13 September. From 5 September 2026 the new logo and brand identity will be integrated across AJ Bell’s D2C platform. It will then be rolled out to the AJ Bell group website and the AJ Bell Investcentre platform in the advised market during 2027. AJ Bell chief marketing officer Stephen Vowles said: “AJ Bell’s commitment to low-cost, simple products and exceptional service has helped more people feel good about investing and supported our growth into one of the UK’s most successful retail investment brands. “We are already trusted by more than 750,000 direct-to-consumer and advised customers, and our refreshed identity will help us introduce AJ Bell to an even wider audience across both markets.”

items.title: SettleMint India Rebrands as Quadcentrix to Mark Expansion Beyond Blockchain into AI, Data Analytics and Enterprise Digital Solutions - indiagazette.com
items.raw_summary: SettleMint India, today announced its strategic rebranding to Quadcentrix, marking its evolution from a blockchain technology specialist into a comprehensive enterprise digital solutions provider. The new identity reflects the company's expanded capabilities across artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics and other emerging technologies, positioning it to help enterprises navigate increasingly complex digital transformation journeys. The rebranding comes as India's enterprise technology landscape undergoes a drastic transformation. The country's enterprise AI market is projected to grow from approximately USD 13 billion in 2025 to more than USD 130 billion by 2032, according to Fortune Business Insights, while IBM's Global AI Adoption Index found that 59% of large Indian enterprises already have AI actively in use, the highest share among the countries surveyed. As that shift accelerates, enterprises are increasingly looking for a single technology partner that can move fluidly across AI, blockchain and data, rather than stitching together point solutions from different vendors. Quadcentrix, formerly SettleMint India, has emerged to meet this demand. The rebranding signifies the company's evolution from a blockchain specialist into a full spectrum technology partner, spanning enterprise AI orchestration, blockchain trust, and data transformation. Founded in 2019, the company has spent over six years delivering enterprise technology infrastructure, building a track record that today includes 20+ enterprise clients globally, with services and solutions delivered across 5 countries. Its work covers diverse sectors including Banking and Financial Services (BFSI), Government and Public Sector, Capital Markets, Agritech and Healthcare & Life Sciences. Having established itself in India in the last few years, the company plans to leverage its strong foothold and target a double-digit growth in the first year of the rebranded entity. "The market has moved faster than the vendor categories built to serve it," said Shahzad Fatmi, CEO of Quadcentrix. "Our clients no longer come to us with a single blockchain problem to solve. They come with a business challenge that spans data, AI and trust, often all at once. Over six years, we built the team and the track record to meet them there, and Quadcentrix is the name that finally reflects that breadth." The name 'Quadcentrix' is built around two key ideas

items.title: Converse lança coleção de tênis inspirada em Dragon Ball Z
items.raw_summary: A Converse lançou no Brasil uma coleção em edição limitada desenvolvida em parceria com a franquia Dragon Ball Z. O destaque dos novos tênis é o fato do design ser guiado pelos personagens mais marcantes da obra. A coleção contempla o modelo Chuck 70, que traz telas em canvas premium e gráficos inspirados no dragão Shenron, além do Chuck Taylor All Star, que apresenta estampas e detalhes temáticos dedicados a Goku, Vegeta, Frieza, Cell, Buu... O post Converse lança coleção de tênis inspirada em Dragon Ball Z apareceu primeiro em Meio e Mensagem - Marketing, Mídia e Comunicação .

items.pme_pt: Mostra como marcas de qualquer tamanho usam parcerias culturais para criar identidade visual diferenciada e gerar buzz sem grande investimento em mídia convencional.

items.title: Natura leva prévia do Palco Sunset para SP em show gratuito
items.raw_summary: A Natura promoverá, no dia 20 de agosto, uma prévia do Palco Sunset do Rock in Rio 2026 na Casa Natura Musical, em São Paulo. Batizado de Especial Palco Sunset, o evento gratuito reunirá João Gomes, Zaynara e Os Garotin, três atrações que também integram a programação do palco no festival. Com curadoria de Zé Ricardo, vice-presidente artístico da Rock World, o encontro faz parte da parceria entre a marca e o Rock in Rio...
